parsed.name: OpenBCI 生物电采集板（LSL流输出）
parsed.name_en: OpenBCI biosignal acquisition board with LSL streaming
parsed.description: 用于初始化和控制 OpenBCI 生物电采集板，并将采集到的多通道数据通过 Lab Streaming Layer（LSL）发布。代码证据显示其可进行串口板卡初始化、默认通道配置、菊花链接入设置、开始/停止采集以及通道位置信息管理，适合脑电等生理信号实验的数据采集与实时流传输。
parsed.description_en: Used to initialize and control an OpenBCI biosignal acquisition board and publish multichannel data through Lab Streaming Layer (LSL). The evidence shows serial board initialization, default channel configuration, daisy-module handling, start/stop acquisition, and channel location metadata management, making it suitable for EEG and related biosignal experiments with real-time streaming.

actions.description: 初始化采集板，并设置自动检测、端口或菊花链等参数。
actions.description_en: Initialize the acquisition board and set options such as autodetection, port, or daisy expansion.

actions.description: 设置采集板的默认配置，如初始通道数等。
actions.description_en: Set the default board configuration, such as the initial channel count.

actions.description: 将当前板卡配置应用到设备。
actions.description_en: Apply the current board settings to the device.

actions.description: 发送一帧采样数据到流输出。
actions.description_en: Send one sample frame to the stream output.

actions.description: 创建 LSL 流信息与输出通道，并设置元数据和通道信息。
actions.description_en: Create the LSL stream information and outlet, including metadata and channel information.

actions.description: 清理采集与流输出相关资源。
actions.description_en: Clean up resources related to acquisition and stream output.

actions.description: 开始从采集板采集并输出实时数据流。
actions.description_en: Start acquiring from the board and output a real-time data stream.

actions.description: 停止数据流，并清理串口缓冲等残留状态。
actions.description_en: Stop the data stream and clear leftover state such as serial input buffers.

actions.description: 初始化板卡状态，执行基础控制命令，并启动采集流程。
actions.description_en: Initialize the board state, issue basic control commands, and start the acquisition process.

actions.description: 修改通道位置信息，用于更新流中的电极位置元数据。
actions.description_en: Change channel location information to update electrode position metadata in the stream.
